finding.expected: Keep the null-safety correction but remove generic non-string stringification. Trim and preserve only actual string values. Missing/None/non-string title or href must be treated as malformed required data and the card skipped; missing/None/non-string shop_name and shop_id must remain None. Preserve item-id identity semantics by accepting only the existing string attribute domain (None/non-string must not be stringified into a new identity value), allowing the existing URL fallback to operate unchanged. Add narrow regression coverage proving malformed non-string values are not fabricated while the explicit-None cases from TASK-153 remain green. Do not change TASK-151 readiness, extraction selectors, parsing helpers, orchestration, browser behavior, or any other production module.
finding.issue: TASK-153 is limited to null-safety while preserving existing Shopee identity and mapping semantics and forbidding fabrication. The candidate uses str(...) coercion for every non-None title, href, item_id, shop_name, and shop_id value. That is broader than explicit JSON-null handling: a malformed non-string payload such as numeric title, href, shop field, or item_id can be converted into a new textual marketplace value or can alter source-product identity instead of remaining malformed/absent. In particular, converting raw_item_id through str(...) changes the input domain of the existing extract_shopee_product_id authority even though TASK-153 explicitly forbids changing candidate identity construction.
